notes.title: Refind Self: The Personality Test Game is Out Now on Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
Refind Self: The Personality Test Game, an adventure game by 7 Days to End with You creator Lizardry, has been released for the Nintendo Switch today (October 3, 2024)!

Ever since its release on Steam last November, many players have shared their thoughts and experiences with the game through Steam reviews, social media posts, videos, and streams, which has helped spread the game to many people all over the world and gathered many players to play with one another.

And it's thanks to our players that we can release the game on the Nintendo Switch! Thank you very much for your continuous support.

If you own 7 Days to End with You on the Nintendo Switch, you can purchase Refind Self at 20% off until October 9 as a launch discount!

Personality test result IDs can be shared and compared across different platforms, so please tell this good news to your friends who would like to join in on their Switch!

notes.title: Lizardry's New Game "Refind Self: The Personality Test Game" has Released!
notes.content:
Dear all,

I'm Lizardry, the developer.
Thank you very much for enjoying 7 Days to End with You.

I have some exciting news to share with you today.
Today is the release date of my newest game, Refind Self: The Personality Test Game!
The game is a personal challenge of mine to create a game themed around the age-old question "Do games really show someone's personality?"

It's a simple exploration-based adventure game, where you play through the story of an android and come to learn your personality in the process.
Each playthrough takes roughly an hour to complete, and the personality test concludes at the end of the third playthrough.
It's very simple and easy to play, so please pick it up if you're interested!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2514960

notes.title: Nintendo Switch Feature Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As announced previously, in conjunction with [i]7 Days to End with You[/i]'s Switch release today, PLAYISM has officially been granted with publishing rights to this title on Steam. 

We've also released the major update that will add all new features originally planned for the Switch version to the Steam version.

[h1][b]New Publisher & Steam Major Update[/b][/h1]
As we, PLAYISM, take over publishing duties, we would like to thank all of you for your support of the title and we hope that you will enjoy the brand new content added today!

The price of the game on Steam has also increased from $5.99 to $7.99, but users who already own the game on Steam will receive the update for free.

[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
The aforementioned update will include the following features.
[list]
[*]Brand-new endings
[*]New reactions for the red-haired person
[*]Bug fixes
[*]Clicking on a word from a conversation box will now open up that specific word in the word list
[*]Controller support
[*]Gallery mode (unlocks after clearing game)
[*]Improved in-game localizations (incl. UI)
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update & Publisher Change Notice
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have two important announcements for you today, so please read on for more information.

[h1][b]New Publisher[/b][/h1]
With PLAYISM publishing the Nintendo Switch version later this month on Jan 26, we are excited to announce that PLAYISM will also be taking over as the Steam version's publisher.

As some of you may already know, the Switch version comes with brand-new features not available on Steam. Therefore, we will be updating the game on Jan 26 at 12am PT to implement those features so that both versions will be the same.

While the price of the game on Steam will increase from $5.99 to $7.99, users who already own the game on Steam will receive the update for free.

[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
The aforementioned update will include the following features.
[list]
[*]Brand-new endings
[*]New reactions for the red-haired person
[*]Bug fixes
[*]Clicking on a word from a conversation box will now open up that specific word in the word list
[*]Controller support
[*]Gallery mode (unlocks after clearing game)
[*]Improved in-game localizations (incl. UI)
[/list]

I hope you're all looking forward to this update!
